Buy a Turkish Passport on Telegram

Somebody is selling a Turkish passport on Telegram right now and the advert almost certainly quotes a price below 3000–11000 TRY. Whether that price is honest depends on what is in the envelope, not on how confident the seller sounds.

Document type
A passport is the travel document a state issues to its own nationals. It is the only document on this site that proves nationality rather than residence or entitlement.

buy turkish passport on telegram – the short version

The band you should expect for a Turkish passport is 3000–11000 TRY. Below the bottom you are buying a print and should be told so. Above the top you should be getting a number that was registered rather than invented.

The figure above is a range rather than a quote, and it moves with stock and season. Hold it in your head as a filter, not as a target, and treat every deviation as a claim to be tested.

Buy a Passport via Telegram: how the transaction works

Payment is usually a transfer or a crypto address and neither is reversible. Split it: a deposit for the data page photo, the balance against a tracking number that moves.

A live video call is worth ten photos. Ask the seller to hold the card to a window in daylight and tilt it slowly. The ghost image and the laminate edge are both visible on a call and neither can be staged with a print.

Who actually issues a Passport

the Nufus Mudurlugu is the body to check against. If a seller cannot name the office that issued the document in the photo, the photo is probably borrowed from a stock gallery.

Where no public route exists, the physical checks carry all the weight. That is not ideal, but it is the honest position and any seller who claims otherwise is overselling.

Replica or registered original

Ask the direct question in writing: does the number resolve at the office, yes or no. A seller who says yes and hedges is selling stock. A seller who says no and prices accordingly is honest.

Where the country has no public register route, the tier question becomes harder to prove. In those cases, buy stock at the middle of the band and do not pay top-tier prices on an unprovable claim.

What a fair price looks like

The bottom of the 3000–11000 TRY band buys a data page print. The middle buys correct stock and the right print method. The top buys a number that resolves at the Nufus Mudurlugu. Ask which one is quoted.

Delivery is part of the price and worth separating. Tracked delivery costs the seller money, and a quote that excludes it is not comparable to one that includes it.

The buying process, step by step

Six steps, in this order. The order matters more than any single step.

  1. Ask which office issued it and confirm the answer is the Nufus Mudurlugu.
  2. Request an uncropped photo of the full card on a plain surface with the laminate edge in frame.
  3. Request a UV shot of the data page and a close crop of the number field.
  4. Test the number against the format the Nufus Mudurlugu uses. A number that breaks the format ends the deal.
  5. Agree a price inside the 3000–11000 TRY band and pay in two parts, deposit then balance against tracking.
  6. On arrival check the document against the photos before you accept delivery and photograph the unopened envelope.

Checks that catch bad stock

Every check here targets something a seller cannot fake without real stock or real equipment.

  • Check the identity card for the citizen number and confirm it against the published algorithm.
  • Confirm the passport coat of arms and the machine-readable zone check digits.
  • Check the number format against the published rule for the Nufus Mudurlugu. Constructed numbers cannot be invented by hand.
  • Look for the UV print with a 365 nanometre torch. Real ink is sharp and placed deliberately. A print shows a dull bloom or nothing.
  • Loupe the microprint and the ghost image. Both collapse into a dotted line or a grey patch on a photocopy.
  • Compare the data across every field for internal consistency. A postcode that contradicts the state or the office area is a tell.
  • Check the laminate or polycarbonate edge for a fused seal rather than a cut line under a laid sheet.

Red flags that should end the conversation

If you see any of these, stop paying attention to the price.

  • An identity card whose citizen number fails the mod eleven algorithm.
  • The seller cannot name the issuing office, only the country.
  • The number breaks the published format, or is round and repeating.

Frequently asked questions

What should a passport cost on Telegram?

Between 180 and 900 US dollars depending on whether you are buying a print, correct stock, or a number that resolves at the issuing office.

Is a Telegram passport genuine?

Usually not. Most adverts sell a replica or a registered original, and the two are priced very differently. Ask which one it is in writing.

How long does delivery take?

Adverts quote anything from same day to four weeks. A tracked number that moves inside 48 hours is the realistic standard.

Can a passport number be checked?

Only against the issuing office register or an airline check-in system. A seller who offers no route to a register check is selling a print.

What is the most common fake?

A colour photocopy of a real data page laminated into a blank cover with a plausible number typed in.

Before you pay

If you have a Turkish passport in front of you and something feels off, compare it against the list above before you send anything.
